scenes.title: Opening Theme and Pushback Against the Revamp
scenes.summary: Following the opening theme song, a veteran singer warns Wen Simo about Chun Yuqiao, Xingtian's chairwoman brushes off executive protests against Chun Yuqiao's overhaul, and the network director storms into the Chief Editor's Office demanding to see Chun Yuqiao.
scenes.location: Opening credits, lounge, and Xingtian Chief Editor's Office

scenes.title: He Means Every Word
scenes.summary: After sending the angry network director away, Bu Xiaogu praises Xingzi's foresight, and Xingzi explains why Chun Yuqiao's uncompromising style rattles executives even though he trusts his team deeply.

scenes.title: Territory Off Limits
scenes.summary: Xingzi asks Bu Xiaogu how close she has grown to the Fentuan fan-club leader and drops a cryptic hint about why Chun Yuqiao lost his temper the day he left the hospital.

scenes.title: Peace and Quiet on the Studio Floor
scenes.summary: Hiding from protesting executives by hauling gear on the studio floor, Chun Yuqiao asks Kaiwen to apologise to the crew for his earlier outburst over the cake before lunch boxes arrive.

scenes.title: Sharing a Bland Box Lunch
scenes.summary: Xin Huimei visits the studio on the pretext of checking the stage, calls her agent to play along, and happily shares Chun Yuqiao's unseasoned recovery lunch while joking about her early-career diet meals.

scenes.title: Rehearsing a Dinner Invitation
scenes.summary: Convinced by Xingzi's hint that Chun Yuqiao likes her, Bu Xiaogu comically rehearses asking him to dinner in the corridor until Lin Jie spots her and points her inside the studio.

scenes.title: Wen Simo Arrives Looking for Chun Yuqiao
scenes.summary: Wen Simo stops Bu Xiaogu in the lobby to confirm that both Chun Yuqiao and Xin Huimei are in the studio, while a colleague invites a distracted Bu Xiaogu to an evening musical.
scenes.location: Xingtian lobby and Chief Editor's Office

scenes.title: Wen Simo's Warning
scenes.summary: Waiting until everyone else leaves the studio, Wen Simo warns Chun Yuqiao that hurting Xin Huimei will make them bitter enemies, and Chun Yuqiao calmly replies that Xin Huimei has just confessed her sincere feelings.

scenes.title: Keeping Watch All Afternoon
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao discovers Bu Xiaogu waiting outside Xingtian all afternoon with numb legs because she saw an unhappy Wen Simo looking for him and stayed to keep watch.

scenes.title: Fan-Club Charity Event and Late-Night Return
scenes.summary: The wealthy Fentuan leader crashes Xingtian's lot to invite Bu Xiaogu to Xin Huimei's charity event, after which Bu Xiaogu insists on heading back to Xingtian late at night because Chun Yuqiao is still working.

scenes.title: Never Belittle Yourself
scenes.summary: Bringing medicine to Chun Yuqiao late at night, Bu Xiaogu worries that her revamp proposal was too hasty, and Chun Yuqiao firmly tells her never to put herself down even if others look down on her.

scenes.title: Three Obstacles and a Bold Question
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao outlines the three major forces opposing the Twelve Singers revamp—advertisers, the television network, and artists—and Bu Xiaogu plucks up her courage to ask him out for a drink.

scenes.title: Bu Xiaogu Laments Her Unanswered Invitation
scenes.summary: Over drinks at home with her roommate, a mortified Bu Xiaogu agonises over Chun Yuqiao's silence after she invited him out and dramatically vows to prove herself at work.

scenes.title: Throwing Herself Into the Revamp
scenes.summary: Having stayed up all night writing the three revamp obstacles on cards, Bu Xiaogu declares she will pour all her energy into work and volunteers to win over the advertisers and DTS.

scenes.title: Why Talent Agencies Resist
scenes.summary: Kaiwen and Xingzi explain why talent agencies are boycotting the revamped Twelve Singers format to protect their stars' easy fees and reputations, sparking an idea in Bu Xiaogu.

scenes.title: Sounding Out the Boss Within Three Days
scenes.summary: Baffled by Bu Xiaogu's sudden burst of zeal, Xingzi and Kaiwen wonder what Chun Yuqiao really feels, and Kaiwen promises to sound him out within three days so their boss can finally find happiness.

scenes.title: A Crash Course in Work-Life Balance
scenes.summary: Bringing Chun Yuqiao boiled cauliflower at noon, Kaiwen claims the chairwoman enrolled him in a scientific work-life course and pressures Chun Yuqiao into a one-minute buddy chat about romance.

scenes.title: Normal Rules for Asking Someone Out
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao calls Kaiwen back to ask hypothetically what to do if a girl invites him for tea, Kaiwen urges him to ask her out again to make amends, and Kaiwen reports his breakthrough to Xingzi.
scenes.location: Chun Yuqiao's office and Chief Editor's Office

scenes.title: The Only Card Left to Play
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu consults Xingtian's artist-management director on breaking the agency boycott, and he advises bypassing the agencies through Xin Huimei—the only star influential enough to turn the tide.

scenes.title: Open Day Intrusion at Production Unit One
scenes.summary: During Xingtian's Open Day, the Fentuan leader barges into Production Unit One and blurts out his crush on Bu Xiaogu in front of Chun Yuqiao before bumping into the chairwoman downstairs.
scenes.location: Xingtian Production Unit One and lobby

scenes.title: The Vice President Offers Two Days to Break the Deadlock
scenes.summary: Xingtian's vice president unexpectedly endorses Bu Xiaogu's revamp plan and asks Chun Yuqiao for two days—and Bu Xiaogu's cooperation—to help break the deadlock.

scenes.title: Did the Boss Invite You for Tea?
scenes.summary: Heading to DTS with Xingzi, Kaiwen assigns Bu Xiaogu urgent tasks and eagerly asks whether the Fentuan leader confessed to her and whether Chun Yuqiao has invited her out for tea yet.

scenes.title: A Mysterious Birthday Delivery
scenes.summary: Xiaoye hands Bu Xiaogu a romantic express birthday gift, leaving Bu Xiaogu baffled because she is single and has never told anyone in the city her birthday.
